The later FSINFO descriptor records the start of its body in `mesg->raw` and stores `mesg->raw_size = 0`, so any later decode of that descriptor receives an empty message body.

A different FSINFO message earlier in the same extension object header has a 32-byte body whose first byte is `0x00`, so when `H5F__super_read` decodes that first FSINFO it takes the version-0 path and sets `fsinfo.mapped = TRUE`.

Because the first FSINFO decoded as mapped and the harness opened the file with `H5F_ACC_RDWR`, `H5F__super_read` takes the rewrite path that removes all FSINFO messages from the superblock extension.
